description: REQ-Q5 hard-codes a 14-day rolling window for ROI dormancy, citing 'sprint-1 REQ-B5 rolling_window'. Sprint-1 REQ-B5 explicitly defines roi_7day_jpy over a 7-day window. The sprint-2 spec invents a new 14-day boundary and falsely attributes it to inheritance. This silently changes the kill-switch latency (doubled), without justification or PROP coverage. The dormancy criterion either inherits 7 days or the spec must call out the deliberate change with rationale.

evidence.snippet: IF cumulative ROI (= sprint-1 REQ-B5 rolling_window) has been < 0 for 14 consecutive days AND the slot is not freshly seeded, THE SYSTEM SHALL write ~/loops/<slot>/.dormant.sentinel
